translations.web: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
translations.bsb: He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
translations.kjv: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
translations.asv: Walk with wise men, and thou shalt be wise; But the companion of fools shall smart for it.
